question: Which inner faculties and bodily actions are included in the offering?
premises: Mind, intellect, thought, and ego are listed.
Actions born of the body are also listed.
These items extend the totality to be offered.
inference: The inner faculties and body-born actions are part of the disciple's totality offered in the ritual.
plain_english: Mind, intellect, thought, and ego, and the actions born of the body.
